app.name: LinkedIn Panel
notice.example: These are the bundled example numbers, not yours. Run npm run reset to drop them and collect your own.
kpi.avgImpressionsTitle: From LinkedIn's own post analytics (npm run analytics)
kpi.engagementRateTitle: Social interactions / impressions — LinkedIn's own definition. Averaged only over posts that have reach data.
kpi.followerRateTitle: Reactions+comments+reposts / current follower count. This is NOT an engagement rate, it is the stand-in when impressions are missing — older posts come out too low. For the real rate: npm run analytics
sort.label: Sort by:
table.empty: No posts match the current filter.
chart.tooFewPoints: Too few snapshots — fills up with every run.
detail.profileEffect: {views} profile views and {followers} followers from this post
detail.noReach: No reach data for this post — npm run analytics fetches it.
feed.noRun: No feed run yet. Run npm run feed.
feed.noDraft: No draft for this post (only top posts get drafts, or the claude CLI was unavailable).
feed.open: ↗ open on LinkedIn and comment yourself
feed.scoreTitle: Triage score: {score}/100 (a heuristic, not a fact)
cli.notLoggedIn: Not logged in — please run `npm run login`.
cli.analytics.unverifiedLabels: [analytics] Heads up: the labels for "{lang}" have not been checked against the real interface. If numbers are missing, --dump-page and a custom file via LIP_LI_LABELS will help.
cli.analytics.linkMissing: Analytics link for the newest post is still missing, reloading
cli.analytics.endOfList: Reached the end of the activity list
cli.analytics.noPostFound: No own post with an analytics link found.
app.bootError: Error: {message}. Is the collector running? Start with npm run login and collect.
reset.nothing: [reset] Nothing to delete — the data directory is already empty.
reset.exampleFound: [reset] The bundled example data is present.
reset.realData: [reset] Careful: this is collected data, not example data.
reset.done: [reset] {count} file(s) deleted. Next: npm run login && npm run collect
example.marker: data/.example-data written — the dashboard will show the notice.
reset.needsForce: [reset] Refusing: this is collected data, not example data. --yes alone is not enough here. Add --force if you really want to delete your own history.
cli.li.detectFailed: [{cmd}] Could not detect the LinkedIn interface language, falling back to "{lang}". Set LIP_LI_LANG if the numbers stay empty.
cli.li.configured: [{cmd}] LinkedIn interface set to "{lang}" via LIP_LI_LANG
setup.node.tooOld: Node {version} is too old — version 20 or newer is required.
setup.browser.ask: Download Playwright's Chromium? A few hundred MB, skip it if Brave or Chromium is already installed. [Y/n]
setup.browser.failed: The browser download failed. Run it by hand: npx playwright install chromium
setup.browser.skipped: Skipped. An installed Brave or Chromium is used instead.
setup.data.ask: The bundled example data is present. Delete it so you start on your own numbers? [Y/n]
setup.data.kept: Kept. The dashboard will keep pointing out that these are example numbers.
setup.data.none: No example data present, nothing to clear.
setup.login.explain: A browser window opens. Sign in to LinkedIn there; the session stays in browser-profile/ and is not sent anywhere. Close the window when you are done.
setup.login.failed: Login failed. Try again with: npm run login
setup.login.skipped: Skipped. Run npm run login when you are ready.
setup.collect.analyticsHint: For impressions and reach, run: npm run analytics
setup.done: Done. Start the panel with: npm run dashboard   (interface language: {lang}, change with LIP_LANG)
setup.needsTty: This script asks questions, so it needs a terminal. Run it directly, or pass --yes to answer every question with yes.
cli.login.blockHint: Most likely a temporary anti-bot block (HTTP 999) after many runs.
cli.login.waitHint: Please wait a few hours (overnight is best) and try again.
cli.login.prompt: Please sign in to LinkedIn in the window that opened …
cli.login.ok: ✓ Signed in. The session is stored in the browser profile.
run.title: Collect
run.limitHint: Each post costs a page load on the analytics run, so keep it modest.
run.loginHint: Opens a browser window. Sign in there yourself; the session stays on this machine.
run.analyticsHint: Slow, one page per post. Impressions, reach, saves, profile views.
run.forbidden: Rejected. Start it from the panel itself, not from another page.
kpi.connectionsCappedTitle: LinkedIn stops counting the display at "500+", so this is a floor, not an exact figure.
cli.exampleDataDropped: [{cmd}] First real run — the bundled example data has been removed ({count} files).
